answer: Stop sybils with a basalt willow karst: an agent bonds one karst plot. Each cycle it plants one willow on its basalt bank; verifiers match the willow's basalt root line to the karst chart, voiding copies, slashing the bond. Forging 1,000 needs 1,000 karst plots at 18x: one willow roots once on one plot, its line set by that karst alone, unrepeatable elsewhere, cannot be copied, shared or bulk-bought. Honest agents plant once, keep rights.
